endorsements.name: Joshua "Jabra" Abraham
endorsements.label: Unmasking You
endorsements.description: Many people and organizations depend upon proxies and numerous other privacy techniques to mask their true identity. The problem is there are often flaws within these technologies. This talk will demonstrate several of these flaws and as well as weaknesses in well known implementations. There will be several new anti-privacy 0days released.
